entities.summary: Vitaliy Vyacheslavovich Naumkin ; born 21 May 1945) is a Russian scholar of Central Asia and The Middle East. Naumkin graduated with honors from Moscow State University from the Institute of Asia and Africa, where he studied Arabic and Arab culture. He then served in the Soviet army from 1968 to 1970 as an officer and Arabic teacher.
